title: Reported Bratislava Pochod za slobodu / Pochod slobody of 20 February; occurrence, ownership, and match remain provisional
location: Bratislava; the pre-event lead names Námestie slobody, while the post-event lead also mentions the Presidential Palace and a district police office. The reported route is not independently established.
scope: A single reported Bratislava march; the captured results do not establish a coordinated national or multi-city action.
organizer: Not established. STG002 describes Aleš Svoboda as organizer of a planned 20 February event at Námestie slobody. Whether that is the gathering later described by participant-affiliated STG001 is unconfirmed.
participants_original: No attendance estimate is visible in the captured results. A separate search-only claim about 19 people taken to a police station is not an attendance count.
threshold_50_evidence: The captured results provide no numeric or qualitative crowd estimate establishing 50 or more participants. The separate, unverified claim about 19 detentions cannot be used as turnout evidence.

title.summary: Search-only post-event and pre-event leads describe a Bratislava freedom march/protest around 20 February. Their relationship and event identity are not established.

start_date.summary: STG001 search result reports a march on 20 February; STG002 announces a planned Bratislava march for that date. Neither article body was read and there is no independent event confirmation.

end_date.summary: The search result describes later movement and a police restriction but gives no physical end time/date.

location.summary: STG002 names Námestie slobody. STG001 search result also refers to movement toward the Presidential Palace and a district police office; exact route and stops are unverified.

scope.summary: Both leads identify Bratislava; no captured evidence establishes a nationwide or coordinated multi-city action.

organizer.summary: STG002 attributes organization of its announced event to Aleš Svoboda. STG001 is published by SHO and appears participant-affiliated. Their relationship and organizer/participant roles are not confirmed.

demands.summary: The titles use “freedom march/protest” and STG001 calls on police to join; neither search result states a sufficiently specific demand for coding.

state_target.summary: No captured text establishes that a demand was directed to the Slovak government or a state policy. An appeal to police to join is not itself a clear demand.

participants_original.summary: No crowd estimate is visible. STG003 repeats a 19-person detention claim with unknown date/origin/event link; that figure is not turnout.

participants_min.summary: No result supports a lower attendance bound.

participants_max.summary: No result supports an upper attendance bound.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count or clear qualitative estimate shows at least 50 gathered people; the 19-person claim concerns possible detention, not attendance.

protester_violence.summary: The captured snippets do not establish violence by participants; absence of a report is not coded as no_explicit.

state_response.accommodation.summary: No search result establishes official negotiation or acceptance of a demand.

state_response.arrests.summary: STG003 repeats a claim that 19 people were taken to a police station, but date, underlying source/origin, occurrence, and relation to this march are unknown; arrests remain unknown.

state_response.beatings.summary: The search-only leads do not establish beatings.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: STG001 snippet mentions police encircling the square and blocking later movement; the snippet does not establish a dispersal attempt or its full context.

state_response.ignore.summary: The search-only results do not establish a refusal to respond; no response cannot be inferred from silence.

state_response.killings.summary: No search-result evidence establishes a killing in response to this event.

state_response.shootings.summary: No search-result evidence establishes gunfire in response to this event.

notes: This is a provisional event lead based on search results, not a verified or approved observation. STG001 is a report by Slovenské Hnutie Obrody with apparent participant affiliation; it was not opened. STG002 is a pre-event announcement by Hlavný denník for a Pochod za slobodu at the same square/date and names Aleš Svoboda, but equivalence to STG001 is unresolved. STG003 is a search-only archive page repeating a 19-detention claim; underlying origin, date, and relation to the march are unknown. One exact-URL retrieval attempt for STG001 ended in a cache miss without HTTP status or body; this is a technical failure, not a denial. Keep route, turnout, demand/state target, ownership, and all response values open.
open_questions: Find independent contemporaneous confirmation that a public march occurred on 20 February and establish whether STG001 and STG002 describe the same event.
Establish the concrete protest demand and whether it targeted the Slovak state or state policy.
Find a crowd count or credible qualitative estimate that can establish or rule out the 50-person threshold.
Verify location sequence, route, physical end, and whether the event was limited to Bratislava.
Identify the original source, date, event link, and official attribution for the search-only claim that 19 people were taken to a police station.
Obtain source evidence for each of the seven state-response fields and protester violence; retain unknown unless directly supported.
Review regional, sectoral, rights, and official records for other February actions and establish any cross-month ownership only with evidence.
Compare against the current official baseline and obtain human/independent scientific review before eligibility decisions.
